summary: Cantaloupe, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of the HSR Act waiting period for its pending merger pursuant to the June 15, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger with 365 Retail Markets, LLC (Parent). Under the Merger, MergerSub will merge into Cantaloupe, which survives as a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary. The closing is expected on or about May 8, 2026, subject to remaining conditions. Cantaloupe must redeem outstanding Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at $11.00 per share plus accrued dividends immediately prior to closing. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. Watch for the closing on May 8 and any last-minute conditions.
